g.text: eight steps; each one ends with an output you can say out loud
restate the prompt; ask platform, geography, goal
the persona journey, its pains and jobs
1-2 pains ranked on frequency, severity, impact
three distinct ideas per chosen pain
value vs effort or RICE; the build-first one
one success metric and two guardrails
persona, pain, solution, metric, risk, MVP cut
skip the features until step 5; never skip step 7
